premises.text: Biological spoilage and moisture loss are currently managed with harmful synthetic pesticides and hard-to-scale natural waxes
premises.evidence_span: thanks to pesticides, which take care of biological spoiling factors

premises.text: Microbial fermentation yields biomolecule coatings that protect food without altering customer sensory experience
premises.evidence_span: we harness the power of microbial fermentation to protect our food

premises.text: Biopolymer matrix regulates gas exchange and enhances antimicrobial delivery at low doses
premises.evidence_span: regulates the gas exchange between the fruit and the environment, delaying the ripening process. The coating also provides a structural matrix

premises.text: Performance supports zero-chemical-residue positioning and multi-day shelf-life gains on citrus and climacteric fruit
